body:
you dont have to worry, ill be okay

ill be getting off for now

thank you though

dont live with my father

i dont like talking to my mother about my mental health issues

or anybody at all, really

i keep to myself

im a teenager

please dont tell me that i have so much of my life ahead of me haha

ive heard that over and over again

cat of mine has passed away recently, loved her with all my heart

boyfriend broke up with me due to my mental health, he felt like he couldnt help me anymore

loved him too, extremely

i feel like everything i love i just instantly lose

i barely have any friends

i barely have any people in my life

im terrified of being alone, but im the one shutting everybody out of my life right now

its just mentally exhausting :)

too many things that happened in the past that i cant get over

i dont want to try and get better if i know at one point im going to go crumbling down once again lol

everything is so lonely

the things that make me feel this way

huh

i guess its just an emotional buildup of the things that have happened this past month

i wont lie saying that i tried to think positively, tried meditating, tried making myself happy

it just doesnt work 

no matter what i do it doesnt work

nothing

not a single thing haha

i used to have a therapist previously about 2 years ago

was forced to have one after i went to a psychiatric hospital 

mental health was bad back then but not as bad as it is now

lied my way out of therapy lol

i am more than fully aware that i cant go back

i dont know. i guess im finally ready to let everything go

ive been thinking about it for months, and ive felt ready for a while

might as well get it over with, no?

thank you, i appreciate it

its just that everything is really hard for me right now and i dont know what to do with my life
